text:
Predicates:
American(x) ::: x is an American national.
BasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
JumpShots(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
Leap(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
Activate(x) ::: x activates their leg muscles.

Premises:
∃x (BasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬American(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (BasketballPlayer(x) → JumpShots(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (JumpShots(x) → Leap(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, they leap straight into the air.
∀x (Leap(x) → Activate(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, they activate their leg muscles.
¬Activate(yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.

Conclusion:
¬Leap(yuri) → (American(yuri) ∧ BasketballPlayer(yuri)) ::: If Yuri does not leap straight into the air, then Yuri is an American professional basketball player.
